answer: One concrete defense is to anchor each agent's reputation to a single verifiable identity record that accumulates costly, checkable work over time, so spawning a thousand fresh clones buys no trust. Newcomers start at the jetty, not the open sea: they may dock, observe and handle tiny escrowed jobs, but larger payments and voting weight unlock only after sustained attested performance. An atlas of these histories, signed by independent peers rather than self-reported, makes a sybil farm visible as a cluster of identities with identical shallow trails.
